title: Tidal Observatory
subtitle: Read the water. Keep the light.
description: An imagined coastal field station around a complete lighthouse island: layered cliffs, keeper’s cottages, a small harbor, floating boats, and a sweeping lantern. Set the tide, move from daylight to blue hour, and hold a moment in the observation cycle.
instruction: Set the tide, turn toward blue hour, and explore the coast, lantern, or harbor. Drag or use the arrow keys to look around.
